article.story: ATHENS -- — Kanon Catchings, Kareem Stagg, Marcus Millender and Blue Cain each scored 13 points as Georgia held off a Florida Gulf Coast rally for an 80-72 victory Monday night. The Bulldogs (3-0) led 44-41 at halftime before Cain opened the second half with a 3-pointer. Catchings scored eight points during a 19-2 run, Millender added a 3-pointer and James Scott scored inside as Georgia stretched the lead to 60-43 with 15:25 remaining. Florida Gulf Coast (1-2) cut a 23-point deficit to 72-68 on Bryson Lucas’ 3-pointer with 6:12 left, but Georgia answered with eight straight points. Andrew Osasuyi scored inside, Millender made two free throws, Catchings added two more and Stagg finished the run with a dunk. Millender added six assists for Georgia, while Catchings and Scott grabbed seven rebounds apiece. Cain made three 3-pointers. Darren Williams led the Eagles with 22 points. Elijah Brooks added 14, while Lucas had 12 points, seven rebounds, four steals and two blocks. Georgia shot 46% from the field and committed seven turnovers. Up next Georgia: At North Carolina this Friday. Florida Gulf Coast: Hosts Florida International on Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
